water-cycle-film: Final frame of the Manim water-cycle animation on a dark background: a white cloud labelled Condensation at the top centre and a sun at the top right; rain lines fall from the cloud (Precipitation); blue upward arrows rise toward the cloud (Evaporation) and short green upward arrows rise from a tree (Transpiration); violet downward arrows enter a low hill (Infiltration); cyan arrows lead away from the hill toward the sea (Runoff); the title The Hydrologic Cycle sits above a dark green land strip.
